data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recognised adverse prior year development (net GBP 1.8m) in 2019, driven largely by reserve strengthening in its reinsurance lines. The balance sheet shows opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 20.974m and closing gross claims outstanding of GBP 43.150m. The managing agent attributes elevated net loss activity to catastrophe exposure (notably Typhoon Faxai and Typhoon Hagibis in 2019) although losses on these 2019 events were smaller than the significant events experienced in 2018 (for example the Japan earthquake). The available notes provide net prior-year adverse movement details but do not disclose a single aggregate GROSS prior-year movement figure, so a gross PYD amount could not be reliably extracted.

data.data_quality_notes: An explicit GROSS aggregate prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was not presented in the notes. The notes state an unfavourable prior-year development of GBP 1.8m but this is stated net of reinsurance. The gross claims development triangle is limited (only 2018 and 2019 columns) so it is insufficient to derive a reliable aggregate gross PYD by the preferred triangle method. Consequently prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. Lob-level prior year movements provided in the notes are net of reinsurance; where used above this is noted and confidence reduced.
